description: scriptconv's Misaki-English backend (Phonemizer.MISAKI_EN), the explicit English-locked variant of the Kokoro-TTS G2P library (registered separately from Phonemizer.MISAKI per this PR's one-fighter-per-registry-name rule, even though the two produced identical output on the samples tested). get_ipa('hello','en-US')=='həlˈO' verified on 3 en-US samples.
notes: Verified working for en-US in the shared venv (misaki package installed). pt-PT not supported by this backend, not tested (no Portuguese variant exists in scriptconv's misaki family).
